repositories.name: gta5-nativedb-data
repositories.role: GTA native names/hashes; tools/check-natives.py verifies host/src/natives.h against it
repositories.license: verify before redistribution; reference data only

repositories.name: rpf-archive-rs
repositories.role: RPF7 archive access for the setup's codv-gtapack (GTA's keys from the player's GTA5.exe, update.rpf entries, CODV's DLC pack for the MW2 item in the weapon wheel); the commit SK8V pins

repositories.name: gta-v-data-dumps
repositories.role: GTA weapon, anim dictionary, movement clipset and sound lists; tools/check-data.py verifies data/weapons.json and data/CodVHost.ini
repositories.notes: Large; check-data.py does a sparse checkout of the four files it needs.

repositories.name: iw4L
repositories.role: Engine: Modern Warfare 2 player movement (movement_iw4), weapons (weapon_iw4) and collision traces (trace_iw4), compiled into CodVRuntime.dll through build/overlay/iw4l (tools/prepare_overlay.py, patches/iw4l); the setup's codv-mw2import reads the player's MW2 weapons with fastfile_iw4
repositories.license: Apache-2.0 (iw4L NOTICE preserved in CODV NOTICE)
repositories.notes: APIs change between commits: update the pin only on purpose, together with patches/iw4l. Read docs/provenance before adopting a further crate.

repositories.name: SK8V
repositories.role: project structure reference, and the source of CODV's GTA collision reader (host/src/physics_level.*, host/src/game_probe.*, rust/codv-gtaworld: live.rs, bounds.rs, clean.rs; see NOTICE)
repositories.license: Apache-2.0 (SK8V NOTICE and the Sol4ra credit preserved in CODV NOTICE)
